instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\four_parts.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv in SolidCAM. Set four work offsets for the four parts in C:\Users\User\Desktop\four_parts.step, corresponding to G54, G55, G56, and G57 or equivalent offsets. Run the same Face and Contour operations on each part. Tool definition: T1 is the end mill reused across G54, G55, G56, and G57. Write the required output file(s) to the Desktop using exactly these absolute paths: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-09.nc. [Software] SolidCAM runs inside SOLIDWORKS; start SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` first (adjust path).
